item.title: Building an Agentic Pipeline for Onchain Data Analysis
item.description:
At Blocmates, we used Claude to help us write SQL queries and Python scripts for data analysis. This helped us finish research reports faster, but it also introduced another problem: managing context.

Each new analysis required us to provide Claude with table schemas, API documentation, and other project-specific information. We also had to copy and paste code between Claude, Dune, and other tools. These repetitive tasks took time and introduced opportunities for errors– undermining the time saved by using an LLM in the first place.

item.title: Building a Local AI System for Financial Markets & Digital Asset Intelligence
item.description:
Financial markets generate an enormous amount of information every day, from macroeconomic developments to digital asset markets and protocol governance. In the past, I’ve struggled to keep up with these developments while writing research reports.

So to streamline my research process, I built a locally hosted AI system that aggregates news and market data, identifies important developments, and generates daily research briefings. Using locally hosted language models, the system has reduced my daily news intake from 1–2 hours to approximately 20 minutes.
